description: This file defines the Skill entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a skill with properties such as id, name, description, and its relation to EmployeeSkill entities.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Entity class representing a skill with properties and ORM mappings for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the skill.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the skill.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the skill.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the skill.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the skill, if any.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the skill.
